nodes.label: GET /autopo/config/{configType}/{serverGroup}/{configCondition} - Get Active Config Value
nodes.rationale: Auto PO configuration is keyed by the triple (configType, serverGroup, configCondition), so the same condition such as skip_level_1_RFQ can carry different values per SAP server group (BCG vs GEMS).

edges.source_location: serverGroup path parameter (BCG) is drawn from the server_groups list
